llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must define and register a Details screen route in the stack navigator.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: Details screen is defined as DetailsScreen and registered under the 'Details' key in the static stack navigator.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must update header title from `useLayoutEffect` to avoid flicker on initial render.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: DetailsScreen calls navigation.setOptions inside React.useLayoutEffect, which runs synchronously before paint to prevent flicker.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must construct navigation with React Navigation static API and render it via `createStaticNavigation(...)`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: createNativeStackNavigator is called with a static config object and the result is passed to createStaticNavigation, which is rendered as <Navigation />.

llmJudgeRequirements.description: Must set the stack header title in screen logic via `setOptions`.
llmJudgeRequirements.reason: navigation.setOptions({ title: route.params.name }) is called at runtime inside DetailsScreen to update the stack header title dynamically.
